description: Fetch one connected marketplace in detail: every adapter on it with its setup state, last poll, last poll error, last catalog-sync outcome (`sync`, whose `lastSuccessAt` is the last run without a connection error — it survives failures, so it says how long a channel has been broken) and last product import, a classified `problem` (kind, needsReconnect, platformMessage, whatToDo) when anything failed, plus the channel sales, leads and product counts. For google_merchant each adapter also has `setup`: setupBlock (what stands in the way: not_connected, no_account, no_country, no_terms, not_armed — owner setup, not an outage), armed, lastPreviewAt, feedLabel, currency, termsAccepted, productUrlTemplate and contentLanguageOverride. Reads stored state only, never calls the marketplace. Use list_marketplaces first to see which platforms are connected, list_channel_products for the products on the channel and check_channel_readiness for what would be refused.

platform.description: The marketplace slug returned by list_marketplaces (prom, rozetka, woocommerce, shopify, olx, amazon, ebay, google_merchant).
